name: cal-10-click-springs
version_tag: CALENDAR (shiura 7035937 Ver.2) — click springs, REPRINT IN BLACK. The originals came off cal-07, which printed entirely in white because `pc start`'s --ams-slot defaulted to tray 0; the axis, bearing and axis-L from that plate are buried in the assembly and were left white, but the click-stop springs may be partly visible, so these get redone in the right colour. WHAT THIS PART IS: click-spring-4copies.stl is ONE connected body 55.28 x 9.03 x 11.24mm, not four loose pieces — four springs joined in a curved crescent bar that must be snapped or cut apart after printing. It reads as a single half-moon on the plate preview, which is why the four springs are easy to go looking for and not find. BRIM 8mm, not the 5mm used on the drums: contact-area-over-height is 20 here (221mm2 holding up 11.2mm), which sits below the 79 of the month drum that detached on cal-03 and in the same band as main-axis and axis-L, both of which needed 8mm. auto_brim would give this zero. Single colour, no purge. Black resolves to TRAY 3 — tray 2 ran empty during cal-06 and the AMS read picks up the survivor automatically. Springs are the part most likely to break in service or on separation; a second copy costs about 2g and no extra heat-up if spares are ever wanted.
